column3: MT 56:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts the last clause in parentheses; the tune name is transliterated “Jonath elem rehokim.” “Has crushed me” is rendered “has trampled upon me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “height” is rendered “proudly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “flesh” is rendered “mere man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “their plans” is rendered “their thoughts.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my heels” is rendered “my steps.”
The Hebrew reads “Because of wickedness, escape for them?”; NASB renders “cast them forth.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “skin-bottle” is rendered “bottle,” and “scroll” as “book.”
